title: Annotatio V §.X open: Quarta Probatio — digna discretio essential; assumes untainted Supper doctrine
pass_a_gloss: §. X. The Author’s Fourth Proof had pressed that worthy discernment of Christ’s body in the Holy Supper, as essential to Christian faith, necessarily presupposes untainted doctrine of the Holy Supper — which Negation of Oral Eating would not be.
pass_b_english: §.X opens the Author’s Fourth Proof: worthy discernment of Christ’s body in the Supper is treated as essential to Christian faith.
That claim, he urged, necessarily assumes an untainted Supper doctrine — which denying Oral Eating would not leave intact.
source_text: §. X. Quarta Autoris Probatio urserat, dignam corporis Christi in Cœna S. discretionem, tanquam fidei Christianæ essentialem, necessario verò doctrinam de S. Cœna intemeratam, supponentem, qualis non esset Negatio Oralis Manducationis.

lemmas.gloss: untainted doctrine of the Holy Supper
